description.narrative: HCFC Phase-out Management Plan (stage I) #Stage I of the HPMP is expected to reduce HCFC consumption by 15 per cent of the baseline (i.e. a proposed reduction of 10.6 ODP tonnes of HCFC) for the period 2014 to 2018. During the period 2014-2020, emphasis will be given to strengthen the policy and regulatory aspects, and to provide technical assistance to customs authorities and the servicing sector#. Activities /project Implementing 1. Policy and regulation support programme (UNEP) 2. Investment projects to eliminate consumption of HCFC-141b in bulk (UNIDO) 2.1. SOFAP 2.2. SNCFT 3. Investment project to reduce consumption of HCFC- 22 in 4 companies in the manufacturing of residential air conditioning (UNIDO/FRANCE) 4. Technical assistance for the reduction of HCFC-22 consumption in the servicing sector 4.1. Incentives and awareness (France) 4.2. Investment activities (UNIDO) 4.3. Training (UNIDO) 5. Technical assistance for customs officials 5.1. Training(UNEP) 5.2. Supply of identification sets (UNIDO) 6. Project management (UNIDO)
